subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt #101863 as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or keep the existing narrower bug reports as the canonical trackers?
rationale: Source evidence confirms the problem class and VISION.md supports stability work, but the proposal chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence shape, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split Track A-D into focused implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A first
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale takeover as the only approved near-term work while deferring durability and completion-drive decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue landing narrow fixes against the existing linked production reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split Track A-D into focused implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned the umbrella and is the clearest owner for deciding whether it becomes the canonical design packet.
